review.en: A Sanskrit verse chronicle of the kings of Kashmir in eight books, written in 1148 and 1149. Kalhana asks that a poet relate the past like a judge, free of love or hatred, and says he consulted eleven earlier chronicles. The early books are legend with impossible reigns; the last ones, close to his own time, are detailed, bitter and precise. It is rare in early Indian writing for its sense of chronology.
review.zh: 这是一部梵文诗体的克什米尔王统纪，分八卷，写于 1148 至 1149 年。迦尔诃纳主张诗人叙述往事要像法官一样不存爱憎，并说自己参阅过前人十一部史书。前几卷是在位年数不可思议的传说，最后几卷接近他的时代，详尽、尖锐而精确。在早期印度著作中，这样的年代意识十分罕见。
